title: If an English prompt gets blocked by Seedance 2’s content fi...
content: If an English prompt gets blocked by Seedance 2’s content filter, translate the same prompt into Chinese and try again to pass the filter faster.
description:
We updated our Seedance 2 prompt guide. 

New find: the content filter is harder on English than Chinese. 

Simple prompts that fail in English pass instantly when translated.

https://t.co/A3ps2eoaOF
